notes: OpenAlex now enforces a shared free daily budget ($0.10, no API key). The run used ~35 requests (25 search queries + batched /sources h-index lookups + 2 targeted lookups) and stayed inside it.

OpenAlex nested primary_location.source does NOT carry summary_stats.h_index; the venue h-index was fetched separately via /sources?filter=openalex_id:S...|S... in batches of 50 (393 sources resolved).

For Sentence-BERT (10.18653/v1/d19-1410) OpenAlex returns source=null (ACL metadata gap). Resolved per the task rule: the venue is EMNLP-IJCNLP 2019, which matches the 'EMNLP' allow-list entry; h-index shown (252) is the EMNLP source h-index.

Jang 2019 (10.1371/journal.pone.0220976) and Arora 2017 (SIF, no DOI in OpenAlex) have NO OA pdf link in OpenAlex. Both PDFs were obtained from their publisher/repository (PLoS ONE, OpenReview) and verified with `file` = PDF; they count as selected.

Semantic Scholar search endpoint returned HTTP 429 throughout (no key); per-DOI lookups worked after ~12 s spacing. S2 citation counts are systematically higher than OpenAlex (e.g. SBERT 21496 vs 12583; SimCSE 4887 vs 2838) - OpenAlex is the value reported in articles[], S2 is the cross-check. 4 arXiv DOIs are not indexed by S2 (HTTP 404).

The 4 seed queries return many off-family works (vision transformers, numeric time-series forecasting) because OpenAlex 'search' matches full text; the family evaluation is in selected / considered_not_selected, not in the raw hit count.
Records were de-duplicated by title (arXiv preprint vs published version); the version with the most citations was kept. This is why total_unique_hits (1057) is below the raw 25x50 fetch.
arXiv source h-index is 760 in OpenAlex, so any arXiv-hosted paper passes the venue gate on h-index alone; this admits preprints (Yin 2018, Mu 2017, Su 2021, Wieting 2015).

GRANULARIDADE (ponto 2): every one of the 429 candidates that passed the objective rules is accounted for - 23 selected with a verified PDF, and 406 in considered_not_selected with an individual written reason. Candidates rejected by an objective rule appear only as a count in rejected_by_gate, since the rule number is the reason.
The funnel closes: 429 mechanical passers = 23 selected + 406 considered; 628 gate-rejected = 1057 - 429.
